initialize_distributed_process_group: initialize a distributed process group using NCCL backend with config for world size and rank
gather_tensor_with_backward: gather tensors from all workers along a batch dimension with support for backward propagation
broadcast_tensor_across_workers: broadcast a tensor or scalar from a source rank to all workers in the distributed group
reduce_dict_across_workers: reduce a dictionary of tensor values across all workers by averaging with all_reduce
encode_object_to_byte_tensor: encode a Python object into a PyTorch byte tensor for distributed communication between workers
